name: City of Sunnyvale Youth Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Youth 13 and older can volunteer at special events, with office tasks, or with young people or seniors, including library roles.
who_can_apply: Age 13 and up. Most roles require volunteers 18 and older to be fingerprinted and cleared first, so ask which roles take teens.
deadline_text: Ongoing. Roles are posted as needed.
how_to_apply: Fill one application: general, library, or recreation and senior center. Volunteer Resources: 408-730-7533.
notes: Official page read directly. Fill out only one application.
